title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Reed Withdraws at BMW PGA
items.text: Patrick Reed withdrew from the BMW PGA Championship with a hand/wrist injury after hitting a shot off a tree root during Friday's second round, ending his Race to Dubai points lead and benefiting Rory McIlroy's bid for a record eighth title.

items.headline: Asian Tour Cuts Ties With LIV
items.text: Asian Tour chief Cho Minn Thant revealed a secret deal made at the Open Championship that shocked LIV Golf and reshaped the global tour landscape, pivoting the Asian Tour away from LIV.
